useCases.tool: trowel, jointing iron, wet stone saw
useCases.sensing: line and level to the string, joint depth, colour mix of the bricks
useCases.reason: Bricks of 2.5 to 5.3 kg are light, but mortar, wall ties and a visible face on an outdoor scaffold are hard; one maker's bricklaying robots work on sites abroad, none is named for German sites.

useCases.sensing: dig depth and slope against the design, buried services
useCases.reason: Pits are dug by 23 to 26 t excavators; a robot could only take the cab seat, where machine control and assistance systems already help the operator.

useCases.sensing: mat temperature, layer thickness, grade and cross slope
useCases.reason: A 20 to 25 t paver and rollers lay hot mix at up to 700 t/h; the crew drives, runs the screed and works in bitumen fumes.
